reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but duplicates daily occurrence selection across three consumers.

duplication.why: Daily exclusion logic appears in getNextDate and both server handlers, while the original weekend mover remains alongside its replacement.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs appropriately in shared schedules, but daily exclusion policy is split between that module and server handlers.

scope.why: All edits address the requested recurrence rules, range handler, holiday configuration, or associated tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate three implementations of daily exclusion and separate occurrence lookahead heuristics instead of owning one shared policy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts: applyWeekendRule replaces its delegation to getDateWithSkippedWeekend with independent adjustment logic while retaining the original helper.

disguised_duplication.where: Daily exclusion is expressed as filtering in getNextDate and getUpcomingDates, and as a continue branch in getDatesInRange.

abstraction_drift.where: WeekendRule gains holidays; getNextDate adds a daily-specific exclusion branch; getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange independently implement that exclusion policy.
